widgets_values: A breathtaking fantasy landscape painting rendered with photoreal detail: a towering island of twisted grey and blue streaked rock rises from a calm turquoise lake, its sides wrapped in lush green forest and hanging vines. A tall white waterfall pours from a cleft near the summit into a round blue pool, and below it a small golden temple with arched windows and two slender stone towers stands on a terrace, joined to the cliffs by a stone arch bridge. Smaller waterfalls spill over mossy ledges into the lake, and tiny trees cling to the rock. The air is perfectly clear, with no mist, fog or haze anywhere, and the island meets the water cleanly. Behind the island a clear cloudless sky fades from pale peach at the horizon to soft blue above, with crisp distant mountains and a wide lake reaching to the horizon. Warm soft morning light from the left, clear crisp detail on every rock, leaf and stone, deep colour, a wide establishing view with the whole island in frame and open water and shore in the foreground.

How the reference pictures align with the target video: Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark.
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A slow, smooth, cinematic drone flight around the fantasy island in Picture 1, in the same painterly photoreal style, warm soft morning light and deep colour. The camera glides very slowly in a wide arc to the right around the island at a steady height, keeping the golden temple and the tall waterfall near the centre of the frame, so the twisted rock, the forest, the stone bridge and the towers turn and reveal their sides, and the far side of the island and more of the lake and shore come into view. The whole scene is completely still and frozen in time like a model: the waterfalls hang as solid white veils, the water of the lake is calm and glassy, the sky stays clear and cloudless with no mist anywhere, no birds or people appear, and only the camera moves. Every rock, tree and stone stays sharp and keeps its exact shape and colour as the camera passes.
overall_soundscape: Silence.
non_diegetic_music: none
